objective: Reduce actual whole-organism bottlenecks using C++/CUDA without changing biological equations, events, input latency or error criteria. Do not promise a target before measurement.

routes.A: Native device-resident adaptive membrane and physical-event transactions; one CPU exchange per declared coupling boundary, same midpoint and error control. Include generic algebraic contraction of redundant channel basis only at roundoff and with full operator checks.
routes.B: Alternative compiled high-order stiff cell solver or mixed-precision linear algebra with FP64 residual/refinement, selected only if measured A remains dominated by arithmetic; retain the same full-state and event criteria.
routes.C: Native/GPU body and asynchronous telemetry: first measure each actual component and Amdahl bound. Promote only if its measured cost materially limits the target; never assume MuJoCo owns 2.5 seconds.

preimplementation.limitation: The synthetic smooth ODE runtime omits spatial membrane work and physical event ownership. Real profile is dominated by hundreds of 17-coordinate midpoint trials and per-event CPU/GPU synchronization.
preimplementation.new_operation: Native controlled trial/accept graphs own temporary candidate state and complete event commits; model descriptors supply kinetics, mass/conductance bases and event observables. Export only at exact existing exchange boundaries.
preimplementation.legal_information: Current state, actual model matrices, declared kinetics/events, current sensor input and physical clock; no desired yaw.
preimplementation.falsifier: At identical inputs native state, event counts, timestamps, histories and outer trajectories disagree beyond roundoff for execution-only changes, or fail fixed integration criteria for a new numerical solver.
preimplementation.control: Same original/full corrected equations and exact initial checkpoint, complete physical states and common observation workload; compare measured full organism, not synthetic speedup.

criteria.whole_short_reference: Existing frozen 5ms PN0.005mV/gates1e-4/global1e-4/yaw1e-4deg/position1e-6m; exact counts/clocks/flags; histories reconstructed.
criteria.long_target: 1 simulated second in approximately60wallseconds is desired, not presumed. Report complete horizon, process time and unresolved fidelity.

scope: No Codex subagents. ChatGPT reviews actual published files, Jev prior routing remains advisory. Original tree read-only. End paused stage3 queue; no further odor runs until integration throughput is addressed.
